verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents its own non-interactive automation surface: a REST API with API-key auth and restricted read/write scopes, batch endpoints of up to 100 requests with webhooks, and a CLI. That supports headless, scripted video generation. However, the CLI is only named in passing, and nothing shows CI pipeline usage or CI-oriented guidance. missing for 10: documented CLI usage and flags for unattended runs, explicit CI/CD integration examples or guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
Map restricted API key read and write scopes to the public endpoints that require them.
